## Cross Sell Opportunities

Maximize the power of custom software with complementary AVENIQ services:

- **AI Automation**: Integrate intelligent LLM document processing, automated email routing, and n8n workflows directly into your custom software.
- **API Integration**: Link your new software system seamlessly with legacy databases, payment platforms, and external vendor systems.
- **Cloud Deployment**: Host your custom enterprise software on secure, containerized Docker infrastructure with automated CI/CD pipelines.
- **Maintenance & Support**: Secure dedicated technical support and continuous feature enhancement services for your custom platform.
